title: CaseProof Evidence and Coverage Contract
compatibility: Do not replace v1 until implementation and contract tests agree

SourceVersion.notes: Tenant scope from trusted auth; parse derivatives carry provenance

EvidenceAnchor.notes: Resolver verifies locator against immutable version

FindingCandidate.notes: Unanchored candidates quarantined; cannot be promoted

PromotionRequest.notes: Actor derived and authorized server-side; exception disposition requires explicit policy and audited rationale

proposed_routes.POST /v2/evidence-anchors: resolve and record typed source anchor
proposed_routes.POST /v2/cases/{id}/promotion: enforce authorization, coverage, support and review gate

errors.409: invalid state transition, missing coverage or unresolved gate

security: Never accept tenant identity or actor authority from untrusted request fields; trusted application context required
